description: This file defines the MailBox class for managing IMAP/POP3 email accounts within the vtiger CRM system, including connection handling, mail fetching, and search functionalities.

classes.name: MailBox
classes.description: Class responsible for managing mailboxes, including connection setup, mailbox retrieval, searching, and overview fetching.

methods.name: MailBox
methods.description: Constructor initializing mailbox connection and list based on parameters.

methods.name: customMailList
methods.description: Fetches a custom list of emails for a specific page.

methods.name: searchMailList
methods.description: Performs search on mailbox and returns a list of matching emails for a specific page.

methods.name: fullMailList
methods.description: Retrieves headers and overview for all emails in the mailbox.

methods.name: isBase64
methods.description: Checks if a given string is Base64 encoded.

methods.name: getImapMbox
methods.description: Connects to the mailbox via IMAP protocol using connection parameters.
